name: Xiangyang Changyuandonggu Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Xiangyang Changyuandonggu Industry Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of diesel engine components in China. The company offers cylinder blocks and heads; connecting rods; and other parts, including flywheel housings, gear chambers, exhaust pipe series products, and main bearing caps, as well as gearbox housings for front, middle, and rear side. It serves engine and vehicle manufacturers. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Xiangyang, China.
